pr_title: portable: reject root directories without an ID field in os-release
pr_comments:
> Fixes https://github.com/systemd/systemd/issues/23445

Looks like this PR is supposed to fix https://github.com/systemd/systemd/issues/23448. The introspection is still broken so https://github.com/systemd/systemd/issues/23445 isn't fixed.

> Nah, it fixes a crash.

I'm not very convinced it's that important... it's an artificial corner case that doesn't exist in the real world, for an exit-on-idle service, IMHO it can wait

By the way I agree it's a corner case but looking at the "extensions" feature a bit closer it appears it wasn't integrated into portabled smoothly. Apart from crashes and memory leaks the "consistency" checks are basically pointless because it isn't that hard to end up having service files belonging to images that have been detached.
It's a corner case, but still, we shouldn't crash. The fix is fairly obvious, let's merge it.

issue_context.title: portabled can't be introspected via DBus
issue_context.body:
**systemd version the issue has been seen with**
https://github.com/systemd/systemd/commit/1ab191b3a95cd511e630e24555ed50205d1ed220

The `/org/freedesktop/portable1/image` hierarchy can't be introspected and it prevents programs like `busctl`, `gdbus` and `dfuzzer` from discovering images automatically (which is the point of the introspection in general)
```sh
# busctl tree org.freedesktop.portable1 --no-pager
Failed to introspect object /org/freedesktop/portable1/image of service org.freedesktop.portable1: Expected image name, not path in place of ''.
└─/org
  └─/org/freedesktop
    ├─/org/freedesktop/LogControl1
    └─/org/freedesktop/portable1

# busctl introspect org.freedesktop.portable1 /org/freedesktop/portable1/image
Failed to introspect object /org/freedesktop/portable1/image of service org.freedesktop.portable1: Expected image name, not path in place of ''.
```

review_comments:
According to https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/os-release.html#ID=
> If not set, a default of "ID=linux" may be used

I'm not sure why portabled would start rejecting images without IDs. It has always allowed attaching images like that.
Yeah, I don't think we should start becoming more strict here.

> Yeah, I don't think we should start becoming more strict here.

The spec is quite clear that an os-release is required https://systemd.io/PORTABLE_SERVICES/ and the os-release spec itself clearly says `This field is optional.` when a field is not mandatory. It doesn't say so for `ID`. I'm not sure an os-release without at least ID can be claimed to be well-formed? Is there any distro actually doing that?
OK, for portable images that is true. So I think we can merge this, even if doesn't fix all the issues.
It's a breaking change nonetheless so I think it should be mentioned in `NEWS`

> OK, for portable images that is true. So I think we can merge this, even if doesn't fix all the issues.
